zh-CN: 新增从同一份 Markdown 构建 DOCX、XLSX、离线 HTML 文档和 HTML 幻灯片。
XLSX 支持样式、工作表、表格、本地图片、合并单元格、列宽、显式公式和图片锚点；公式结果由 Excel 计算。
HTML 文档包含目录、响应式阅读与打印样式；HTML 幻灯片支持章节导航、键盘控制和 PAGEBREAK 分页。
DOCX、XLSX 和 HTML 共享 info 值、文本占位符和富内容引用。安装包增加多格式示例和中英文命令指南。
en: Build DOCX, XLSX, offline HTML documents, and HTML slide decks from the same Markdown source.
XLSX supports styles, worksheets, tables, local images, merged cells, column widths, explicit formulas, and image anchors; Excel calculates formula results.
HTML documents include a table of contents, responsive reading, and print styles. HTML slide decks support section navigation, keyboard controls, and PAGEBREAK breaks.
DOCX, XLSX, and HTML share info values, text placeholders, and reusable rich-content references. The package includes multi-format examples and a bilingual command guide.

zh-CN: 无需单独安装 .NET SDK、Python 或 Microsoft Word。
en: No separate .NET SDK, Python, or Microsoft Word installation is required.

zh-CN: 安装器：下载并运行 FloraDoc-Setup-win-x64.exe，按安装向导完成安装，然后重新打开 PowerShell 并运行 floradoc --version。
便携 ZIP：解压到可写目录，在该目录运行 .\floradoc.exe --version；如需从其他目录调用，请自行将解压目录加入 PATH。
安装器版本可运行 floradoc update 检查更新；便携 ZIP 通过下载新版并重新解压更新。
en: Installer: download and run FloraDoc-Setup-win-x64.exe, follow the setup wizard, open a new PowerShell window, and run floradoc --version.
Portable ZIP: extract it to a writable folder and run .\floradoc.exe --version there. Add the extracted folder to PATH if you want to call it from other directories.
Installer-based installations can check updates with floradoc update. Update a portable ZIP by downloading and extracting the new archive.
